a: Yali musajja Omuyoruba, eyazaalibwa nga mu mwaka gwa 1809 mu kibuga Osogun mu kitundu ekiri kaakano mu bugwanjuba obw'obukiikaddyo bwa Nigeria, eyava mu buddu n'afuuka bisoopu Omwafirika asooka mu kkanisa ey'Abangirikaani. Yawambibwa ng'akyali mulenzi n'oluvannyuma n'asumululwa, era n'awaayo obulamu bwe eri ekkanisa ng'omusumba, omuyivu, era omuvvuunuzi. Ajjukirwa okusinga byonna ng'omusajja eyasooka okutwala Bayibuli yonna mu lulimi Oluyoruba, era ng'omukulembeze omutandisi ow'ekkanisa ey'Ekyafirika.

Mu 1821 entalo ezaali ziriisa obusuubuzi bw'abaddu obw'oku nnyanja Atlantiki zaatuuka ku kibuga kye Osogun, abalumbaganyi ne bakyokya ne batwala abantu baamu nga basibiddwa emiguwa. Àjàyí, ng'alina emyaka nga kkumi n'ebiri, yatwalibwa ne nnyina ne muto we omuwere, n'atambuzibwa okwolekera ennyanja, ng'atundibwa okuva ku mwami omu okudda ku mulala. Mu kibuga kimu, nga bwe yawandiika mu byafaayo bye, kyakkaanyizibwa nti awaanyisibwe embalaasi, era oluvannyuma n'addamu okuwaanyisibwa taaba n'omwenge ogw'amaanyi — omulenzi nga yeetunuulira ng'afuuka ssente.

q: Yawonyezebwa atya okuva ku mmeeri y'abaddu?
a: Ku lubalama lw'ennyanja yatundibwa eri abasuubuzi Abapotugiizi n'ateekebwa mu mmeeri y'abaddu, naye mu ssaawa ntono emmeeri n'ekwatibwa West Africa Squadron eya Royal Navy, eyali eyigga abasuubuzi b'abaddu wansi w'ekiragiro kya Bungereza ekyaggalawo obusuubuzi obwo. Emmeeri eyayimiriza eyiye yali HMS Myrmidon, mu 1822. Mu kifo ky'okumala obulamu bwe mu nnimiro y'abaddu mu Brazil oba Cuba, yatwalibwa e Freetown mu Sierra Leone, ekitundu ekyatandikibwawo okuba amaka g'abo abaasumululwa.

q: Yafuuka atya Omukristaayo era n'atwala erinnya Samuel Crowther?
a: Mu Freetown Church Missionary Society yamusembeza, n'emuyigiriza ennukuta, n'emuteeka mu maaso Ebyawandiikibwa, era n'atuuka okukkiriza nti yali anunuddwa mu buddu obw'omunda ennyo okusinga obwo Royal Navy bwe yamalawo. Nga bwe yakyogera oluvannyuma: "Nga mu mwaka ogw'okusatu okuva lwe nnasumululwa mu buddu bw'abantu, nnakakasibwa nti waaliwo embeera endala ey'obuddu embi n'okusinga, kwe kugamba, obw'ekibi ne Setaani. Kyasanyusa Mukama okuggulawo omutima gwange." Yabatizibwa nga December 11, 1825, n'atwala erinnya ly'omusumba Omungereza gwe yali tasisinkanangako, Samuel Crowther.

q: Ekirabo kye eky'ennimi kyali kitya, era yakikozesa atya?
a: Buli eyakolera naye yalaba ekintu kye kimu: obwongo obw'obugumiikiriza n'obw'okutuuka ewala mu ngeri ey'enjawulo, naddala mu nnimi. Yatandika okwekebejja olulimi lwe olw'obuzaaliranwa n'aluwandiika — amaloboozi, amateeka g'olulimi, n'engero — omulimu kumpi nga tewali n'omu eyali agugezezzaako, era n'akola ekitabo eky'olubereberye eky'amateeka g'Oluyoruba n'enkuluze y'ebigambo. Obuyivu buno bwe bwazimba omusingi gw'omulimu gw'okuvvuunula ogwandimutwalidde obulamu bwe obwasigalawo.

q: Ddala yaddamu okusanga nnyina oluvannyuma lw'okwawulibwa obuddu?
a: Yee, era kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga okwewuunyisa mu lugero lwe. Yoruba Mission bwe yatereera mu Abeokuta, Crowther yasanga mu bantu b'ekibuga nnyina ye yennyini, Afala, gwe yali ayawuddwako emyaka nga amakumi abiri mu etaano emabega. "Tetwasobola kwogera bingi, wabula twatuula kasirise, nga tutunulaganako emirundi mingi n'okwagala, okwagala emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano kwe kwalemererwa okuzikiza," bwe yawandiika. Oluvannyuma nnyina yabatizibwa n'ayitibwa Hannah — omwana eyali omusibe n'afuuka ekkubo ery'okukkiriza kwa nnyina.

Yeewaayo okuvvuunula Ebyawandiikibwa ne Book of Common Prayer mu Luyoruba, ng'azimba amateeka g'olulimi n'enkuluze y'ebigambo omulimu ogwo bye gwali gwetaaga kumpi ng'atandikira ku bwereere, era ng'akola ekigambo ku kigambo ne banne Abaafirika. Bayibuli yonna ey'Oluyoruba yamalirizibwa wansi w'obulabirizi bwe mu myaka gye egy'enkomerero. Olulimi olwali luwandiikiddwa mu bitabo by'abasuubuzi b'abaddu ng'omuwendo gwokka, kaakano lwafuulibwa olusobola okutwala ebigambo bya Katonda.

q: Yafuuka atya bisoopu Omwafirika asooka mu kkanisa ey'Abangirikaani?
a: Ekitabo ky'ennaku kye eky'obwannyonnyofu kye yakuuma mu Niger Expedition eya 1841 kyamuwa erinnya mu Bungereza, era yawongebwa okuba kabona ku Ssande ya Butukuvu, nga 11 June 1843 — omusumba Omwafirika asooka mu Kkanisa ey'Abangirikaani. Ku lunaku lwa St Peter, nga 29 June 1864, mu Canterbury Cathedral, yatukuzibwa okuba Bisoopu w'Ebitundu bya Niger, bisoopu Omwafirika asooka mu kkanisa ey'Abangirikaani. Yazimba obwamisonaali obwali, mu ntekateeka yaabwo, okukulemberwa Abaafirika ku lwa Afirika.

q: Yayisibwa mu bwenkanya ku nkomerero y'obulamu bwe?
a: Nedda, era obwesigwa busaba nti kiyogerwe mu lwatu. Bwe yakaddiwa, omulembe omuggya ogw'abamisonaali Abazungu abato ne gutuuka ku Niger, abaali batakkiriza nti Omwafirika asaanira okukulembera; mu myaka gy'e 1880 baalumba obwamisonaali bwe n'okukebera ebitabo by'ensimbi n'okuloopa okwateekebwa ku bakozi be Abaafirika, nga babagoba era nga babadibwamu kinnoomu. Ng'omusajja ow'eddoboozi eddegevu, teyafuba nnyo kuddamu bulumbaganyi obwatuumibwa ku bantu be, era mu 1890 yawaayo obuyinza bwe mu kitiibwa abamuloopa kye bataatuukako — ng'alemeseddwa abasajja abaalina okubeerawo kwabwe olw'ettaka lye yali atereezezza.

q: Yafa ddi era atya, era kiki ky'atulekera?
a: Yafiira mu Lagos nga 31 December 1891 olw'okukwatibwa obulwadde bw'obwongo, ng'alina emyaka nga kinaana mu ebiri, era obubisoopu obwaddirira ne buweebwa Omuzungu. Naye omusango gw'ebyafaayo ogw'omunda ennyo gwagenda ku luuyi olulala: Bayibuli y'Oluyoruba gye yakola ekyasomebwa, era ekkanisa ey'Ekyafirika eyeefuga gye yakakasa nti eyinza okwemalirira kaakano nnene okusinga bye yalowooza. Omulenzi eyawaanyisibwa embalaasi assibwamu ekitiibwa okubuna essemazinga ng'omu ku bakadde b'okukkiriza kwalyo.
